method: Identical native-touch scene test on isolated source snapshots. Baseline is the git commit; fixed snapshot changes only work/gait handling in game_world.gd and village_person.gd. Assets and import data are shared read-only.

failures: Walking away interrupts the work loop promptly while the domain task remains saved
Saved unfinished work does not make an idle character work at a remote location
Completed station time waits for deliberate handover without an endless work pose
Work hints preserve a current hit reaction
Work hints never resurrect a dead visual actor
